title: Glowing rubber duck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE44D' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE44D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='headGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF176'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='beakGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF8C00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E05500'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow around the duck -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='44' ry='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- water reflection glow -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='82' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.3'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='82' rx='24' ry='4' fill='#FFE44D' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='30' ry='18' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='70' rx='18' ry='10' fill='#FFF59D' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 60 Q86 52 82 64 Q80 68 74 66 Z' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <path d='M76 62 Q82 57 80 63 Q79 65 75 64 Z' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='17' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='38' r='9' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- beak upper -->
  <path d='M22 44 Q14 40 18 48 Q20 52 26 50 Z' fill='url(#beakGrad)'/>
  <!-- beak lower -->
  <path d='M22 46 Q16 48 19 51 Q22 53 26 51 Z' fill='#CC4400'/>
  <!-- beak highlight -->
  <path d='M21 43 Q17 41 19 46 Q20 47 23 46 Z' fill='#FFB74D' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='39' r='4' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='33.5' cy='40' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='48' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M52 62 Q62 58 64 66 Q62 72 54 70 Z' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <path d='M54 63 Q60 60 61 65 Q60 69 55 68 Z' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- little water ripples -->
  <path d='M20 84 Q26 81 32 84 Q38 87 44 84' stroke='#FFE44D' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M52 85 Q58 82 64 85 Q70 88 76 85' stroke='#FFE44D' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='1' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
